canonical_project: Maska Group Mwyndy Cross data centre

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: DCD and local reporting describe a Maska Group planning application filed with RCT Borough Council for a two-story 18,220 sqm data centre plus a 2,260 sqm office block, servicing/energy plant and chillers on vacant land east of the A4119 at Mwyndy Cross. Proposed IT capacity and power source were not detailed.
